At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**Job Description

****Key Responsibilities

**

• Support the planning, setup, and execution of global clinical trials, ensuring activities are delivered in accordance with timelines, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.

• Ensure trial oversight by maintaining accurate documentation and participating in inspection readiness activities.

• Collaborate with CROs and internal stakeholders to support site feasibility, selection, activation, and ongoing site management.

• Drive in the oversight of service providers, tracking deliverables, timelines, and quality to ensure alignment with study expectations.

• Support risk identification and mitigation activities, contributing to risk-based quality management throughout the trial lifecycle.

• Drive in managing protocol deviations and trial-level issues, ensuring proper documentation, follow-up, and escalation as needed.

• Support trial data review and performance tracking, contributing to reporting and identification of potential issues.

• Work collaboratively within a global, matrixed team environment, building strong relationships with internal teams, vendors, and investigators.

**Qualifications

**

• Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or related field (Master’s degree preferred).

• 5+ years of experience in clinical trial management within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.

• Solid understanding of ICH/GCP regulations and the clinical drug development lifecycle.

• Experience managing global, multi-center trials and working in a complex, matrixed organization.

• Project management and service provider oversight skills.

• Good communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.

• Oncology and/or therapeutic area–specific experience is highly desirable.

The proposed gross annual base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK620.160,00---930.240,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible to additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on compensation and benefits will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

**About The Role

**You will join a growing AI team of 19 talented colleagues with a shared mission: transforming data and AI into measurable business value for Flatpay and our merchants.

We are hiring Data Scientists across two areas: improving our KYC and Image AI products, and developing AI-powered customer service automations.

As a Data Scientist, you will design, build, and productionize GenAI and/or Machine Learning powered products and pipelines that support business-critical processes across the organization.

You will own the implementation of solutions together with colleagues from the AI team and the wider business. This includes understanding the underlying business problem, shaping the solution, building it, deploying it to production, and continuously improving it based on real-world performance.

The role is ideal for someone who combines strong GenAI and software engineering skills with the ability to communicate effectively with business stakeholders. You should enjoy turning ambiguous operational challenges into practical AI products that create measurable value.

We are looking for someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, takes ownership, and is comfortable engaging directly with stakeholders to pursue opportunities, align solutions with business needs, and continuously drive improvement.

What You'll Do

• Design, build, and maintain production-grade AI products and pipelines using Python, Databricks, and MLflow.

• Apply traditional machine learning and GenAI techniques, choosing the right approach based on the business problem, available data, and operational requirements.

• Work within one of our key focus areas:

• Customer service: Build GenAI and classical ML powered automations, including ticket classification, information retrieval, response assistance, and workflow automation.

• KYC & Image AI: Build document and image processing workflows that extract and validate information, populate application fields, and integrate with acquiring partners.

• Integrate models and AI applications with internal systems, APIs, and external platforms.

• Write clean, maintainable, and tested Python code, with monitoring, validation, guardrails, and fallback mechanisms appropriate to the use case.

• Evaluate solutions against relevant technical and business measures, including accuracy, reliability, latency, cost, and operational impact.

• Collaborate with data engineers and other technical teams to build on reliable, scalable, and well-governed data foundations.

• Work directly with stakeholders to understand processes, define requirements, and take solutions from proof of concept through production and ongoing improvement.

Who You Are

We are hiring across several focus areas and do not expect you to have experience in all of them. We are looking for a strong technical foundation, a practical approach to problem-solving, and relevant experience in the area you would join.

**Required

**

• You have 2–4 +years of industry experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, AI Engineering, or a similar technical role.

• You have strong Python skills and write clean, maintainable, and tested code.

• You understand core machine learning concepts, including data preparation, model evaluation, and validation.

• You have hands-on experience building solutions with traditional machine learning, GenAI, or a combination of both.

• You are comfortable working with SQL and data processing libraries such as Pandas.

• You understand what it takes to move a solution from prototype to production, including testing, monitoring, and reliability.

• You communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders and can translate business needs into practical technical solutions.

• You take ownership, enjoy learning, and care about building solutions that create measurable business value.

**Nice to Have - Depending on Your Focus Area

**Relevant experience in one or more of the areas below is a plus. You do not need to cover every area.

• Customer service and GenAI automation: Experience building LLM-powered applications using structured outputs, tool calling, RAG, or agents, particularly for ticket classification, response assistance, and workflow automation. Familiarity with Freshdesk or similar platforms is a plus.

• KYC and image processing: Experience processing documents and images with multimodal models, extracting structured information, validating data, or integrating with onboarding and verification systems.

Why Flatpay

You’ll be joining an ambitious, metric-driven, and fast-growing fintech company that believes in the power of personal connections, both with our customers and in the way we work with each other Working on early-stage products where you’ll have a sizeable impact on what gets built A modern office with an international and vibrant work environment with free slush ice, an in-office gym, a fully equipped gamer room and plenty of other fun things at the office! If you’re ready to be part of this exciting journey, we would love to hear from you today!

_Do you want to join a global fund manager in energy infrastructure investments? If so, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) is currently looking for an Associate/Sr. Associate to join our Flagship Portfolio Management Team based in Copenhagen.

**Team

**The Flagship Portfolio Management team sits at the heart of our investment platform, overseeing the performance, strategy, and long‑term value creation of our largest and most strategic funds. The team manages the full lifecycle of portfolio assets by monitoring financial and operational performance, analyzing market and asset‑level developments, identifying risks and opportunities, and ensuring alignment with fund strategy. Working closely with investment teams, asset managers, and senior leadership, the team develops portfolio models, reporting frameworks, and decision‑support materials that guide both day‑to‑day management and long‑term planning. Joining the Flagship Portfolio Management team means contributing directly to the success of high‑profile funds in a dynamic, analytical, and collaborative environment

**Role

**You will play a key role in supporting the management and performance oversight of our flagship funds. You’ll gain exposure to high‑profile assets, collaborate with experienced professionals across the organization, and contribute directly to the performance of our flagship funds. It’s an ideal environment for someone who thrives in analytical, fast‑paced settings and wants to play a meaningful role in shaping portfolio outcomes.

**Responsibilities will consist of but are not limited to:

**

• Support the ongoing monitoring and analysis of portfolio performance across Flagship funds

• Maintain, update, and enhance portfolio models, dashboards, and reporting tools

• Prepare high‑quality materials for investment committees, senior management, and investor reporting

• Conduct financial analysis, scenario modelling, and forecasting to support strategic decision‑making

• Track key performance indicators, market trends, and asset‑level developments

• Identify risks and opportunities within the portfolio and support follow‑up actions

• Collaborate closely with investment teams, asset managers, and other internal stakeholders to ensure alignment with fund strategy

• Assist in preparing portfolio reviews, valuation updates, and fund‑level presentations

• Contribute to process improvements and the development of best‑practice portfolio management frameworks

**You

**You are holding a university degree in finance, economic, business or a related field and 1–4 years of relevant experience in investment management, portfolio management, corporate finance, consulting, or a similar analytical role.

**We look for the following in a candidate:

**

• Ability to interpret complex data and communicate insights clearly to senior stakeholders

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including proficiency in creating high-quality PowerPoint presentations

• Self-starter with a structured and disciplined approach to your work, the ability to connect the dots independently, and to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

• Solid financial modelling skills and solid understanding of valuation, forecasting, and performance analysis

• Excellent analytical and problem‑solving abilities, with a high level of attention to detail

• Proficiency in Excel; experience with BI tools or data analytics is a plus

• Comfortable working with large datasets and multiple information sources

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with cross‑functional teams

• High level of professionalism, ownership, and motivation to contribute to fund‑level decision‑making

**The process

**Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

**Building value that matters

**Founded in 2012, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners P/S (CIP) is a global fund manager and leading investor in energy infrastructure. CIP builds value that matters by developing and constructing critical infrastructure projects that shape the future of energy.

Through its funds, CIP invests in power generation (solar and wind), energy storage, transmission and distribution, advanced bioenergy, low-carbon fuels and carbon capture.

With 15 funds currently under management, CIP is trusted by over 200 of the world’s largest and most sophisticated institutions, having raised EUR ~43 billion to date.

CIP has projects in more than 30 countries, with presence on the ground through a network of +2,300 professionals with extensive experience and knowledge within the fields of renewable energy project development and regulated infrastructure. In addition, CIP has a broad range of competencies within corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, engineering, construction, project development, and project management.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, CIP operates from key locations across the globe, including offices in Hamburg, Munich, London, Amsterdam, New York, Tokyo, Melbourne, Luxembourg, Kuala Lumpur, Seoul, and Singapore. In addition, CIP has 17 local project offices globally.

For more information, visit www.cip.com.

jobs.occupation: Head of Pricing Excellence & Commercial Insights
jobs.description:
Do you want to be a valued part of the critical infrastructure that serves communities across Europe and beyond? Are you looking for a position in which you can set direction and help shape our company? If so, then you could be the newest addition to our Commercial Excellence team as Head of Pricing Excellence & Commercial Insights.

At DFDS, we are strengthening how we use pricing, customer data and commercial insights to improve profitability, support growth and create greater value for our customers.

As Head of Pricing Excellence & Commercial Insights, you will play a key role in this transformation. You will drive the development of pricing capabilities, help establish a stronger customer data foundation and turn commercial data into actionable insights that support decision-making across the business.

You will join our Commercial Excellence team, which works across DFDS to enable more efficient, data-driven and profitable commercial operations. Through common tools, processes and insights, we help strengthen commercial performance while supporting local business ownership and flexibility.

Be part of the movement - and play your part.

About The Role As Head of Pricing Excellence & Commercial Insights, you will own and drive DFDS' pricing excellence and commercial insights agenda across a complex, international business.

This is a highly strategic role focused on strengthening pricing capabilities, improving commercial decision-making, and unlocking value from customer and commercial data. Working across business units and functions, you will lead key transformation initiatives, establish scalable frameworks and best practices, and drive the adoption of tools, processes, and data-driven ways of working.

Operating in a highly decentralized organisation, you will balance the implementation of common standards and governance with the need for local ownership and commercial flexibility.

Pricing Excellence and Commercial Insights is an area of increasing strategic importance and executive attention. You will play a key role in elevating its maturity and impact, working closely with Commercial leadership, Data & Technology, Customer Engagement, Tender Management, and Tools & Processes to deliver measurable business value.

**Key priorities

**

• Drive the Pricing Excellence strategy across business units, establishing governance, standards and best practices while enabling local flexibility

• Own the business vision and roadmap for our pricing platform, ensuring continuous development, adoption and value creation

• Lead the digitalisation of pricing processes across CRM, contract management and pricing solutions

• Build and mature Commercial Insights capabilities, transforming data into actionable recommendations and commercial decision support

• Shape the long-term strategy for our customer data foundation in partnership with Data & Technology

• Identify opportunities to improve profitability and reduce revenue leakage through analytics, automation and AI

• Facilitate alignment, collaboration and knowledge sharing across business units and senior stakeholders

• Translate complex data and insights into clear recommendations for management and commercial leadership

**About You

**At DFDS, we believe the strongest teams are built through diverse perspectives, experiences and ways of thinking.

With this in mind, we think that you are a strategic and commercially minded professional who enjoys solving complex problems and turning insights into action. You combine strong analytical capabilities with the ability to influence stakeholders, challenge existing ways of working and drive change across a matrix organisation.

You thrive at the intersection of business, data and technology and are motivated by creating tangible commercial impact through pricing excellence, customer insights and continuous improvement.

We think the ideal person for this position will bring the following:

• 5+ years of relevant experience within Pricing, Commercial Excellence, Revenue Management, Strategy, Management Consulting, Business Development, Finance, Analytics or a related field

• A strong track record of driving cross-functional initiatives and delivering results through collaboration and influence rather than formal authority

• Experience operating in complex organisations with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities

• A strategic mindset combined with the ability to translate ideas and opportunities into practical solutions and business outcomes

• Experience working with commercial tools and platforms such as CRM, pricing, CPQ, contract management or business intelligence solutions

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn data into actionable insights and recommendations

• Interest in leveraging data, automation and AI to improve commercial performance and decision-making

• The ability to communicate complex topics clearly and confidently to both operational teams and senior stakeholders

• A curiosity for understanding customers, commercial processes and business drivers, combined with a willingness to challenge the status quo

Working at DFDS

While you’re with us, we want you to develop. At DFDS, development happens first and foremost through real work. We will also offer training and support when needed.

We promote a great workplace with a diverse and vibrant community. At our Copenhagen headquarters, we enjoy a modern workspace with award-winning facilities, different work zones, own game room, fitness facilities, canteen and a café with a rooftop terrace with a beautiful ocean view, all just 5 minutes from the nearest train & metro station.

Are we a match? Then what are you waiting for? Apply Now.

If you think your personality, skills, experience, and aspirations match this role, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your application as soon as possible, as we’re keen to meet potential candidates on an ongoing basis.

**We look forward to hearing from you.

**This recruitment process is managed by the DFDS Talent Acquisition team. We kindly ask external recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting us regarding this opportunity.

**_

**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

**JOB SUMMARY

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

Are you passionate about renewable energy and eager to work at the forefront of the global energy transition? PEAK Wind is seeking an AI Engineer to help shape our AI roadmap and to build and orchestrate the agents our colleagues and clients will use every day. At PEAK Wind, AI is moving from prototypes into production, and renewable energy operations produce exactly the kind of complex, high-volume data where AI can deliver significant value.

Introducing the Data & Intelligence Team

You will become part of our Data & Intelligence (D&I) team, where we work within PEAK Wind’s asset management service offering and manage full value chain data management for our clients. We support renewable energy assets worldwide through data management, reporting solutions, analytics, and AI capabilities, helping deliver data-driven solutions that support our clients and renewable energy projects. Our team consists of highly motivated professionals who bring diverse backgrounds and a strong commitment to excellence. We support one another, share knowledge, and celebrate both individual and collective achievements.

You will report to the Head of Data & Intelligence and work day-to-day with our small team of engineers who have been building internal AI products at PEAK Wind for several years. You will work closely with colleagues across different areas, bringing your perspective to a collaborative and purposeful team environment.

How You Will Make an Impact

As an AI Engineer, you will take AI solutions from idea to production and keep them there. You will co-own our AI roadmap: helping decide which agents we build, in what order, and what “working” means for each of them. Then you will build them.

Our agent portfolio serves two audiences. Internally, our agents give colleagues across PEAK Wind a well-governed way to work with company knowledge, generate reports, and analyse wind farm performance. Other internal agents help our own engineers specify and build new features faster. Externally, we provide agent-driven capabilities in our client-facing products.

On smaller initiatives you may be the engineer primarily responsible for taking the solution from first conversation to deployment. On larger initiatives, you will work closely with Product Owners, data engineers, and domain experts in asset management. Either way, the distance from an idea to something running is deliberately short. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Co-develop and maintain the PEAK Wind AI roadmap with the AI team, turning business needs into scoped, sequenced deliverables

• Design, build, and deploy agentic systems for internal colleagues, from reporting and wind farm analysis to engineering-productivity agents

• Design, build, and deploy AI-driven features and agents in our client-facing products, working with SCADA, operations, and asset management data

• Orchestrate multi-agent workflows: tool use, memory, retrieval over company and client data, and integration with our platform through APIs

• Build the evaluation systems that tell us whether an agent works, before and after it reaches production

• Own the data and infrastructure work behind your own agents on the cloud.

• Implement responsible-AI practices for operational energy data: access control, data isolation between clients, logging, and guardrails

• Ship early and iterate put prototypes in users’ hands fast and feed what you learn back into the roadmap

• Collaborate with Product Owners and stakeholders to understand what they need, and push back when AI is not the right tool

• Document what you build so others can maintain, extend, and trust it

What Will Make You Successful in This Role

At PEAK Wind, we know success comes in many forms. What matters most is your mindset, curiosity, and drive to make an impact. The following qualities and experiences will help you succeed in this role:

• A degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or similar, or an equivalent track record of shipping software

• Hands-on experience in software development, ML, data engineering, or AI Engineering, including AI applications you have helped take into production

• Strong Python and/or TypeScript, and hands-on experience with at least one agent framework

• Experience building or extending evals for LLM and agent behaviour, or an interest in developing deeper expertise in this area

• Experience building in cloud environments, preferably Microsoft Azure; familiarity with PostgreSQL, APIs, and modern web stacks is an advantage

• You code with AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor as a matter of course

• Professional experience in the energy industry or another complex technical environment; renewable energy or SCADA experience is an advantage but not required

• Clear and effective communication skills in English, both spoken and written, with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike

• A go-doer mentality: you would rather ship something real this week and improve it next week than perfect it in a document

• A structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to take initiative, including owning a product from idea to delivery

• The ability to stay calm and constructive in a high-paced environment

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive in an international, cross-functional team

This role is designed for an engineer who has already gained some hands-on experience building AI solutions and is now looking to deepen that expertise in a highly practical, production-focused environment and enjoys building and learning.

Why Join PEAK Wind

• A real mandate to build with AI: an existing roadmap, internal users who want what you build, and clients ready to adopt it

• An international, inclusive, and diverse workplace where differences are valued

• The opportunity to work on leading renewable energy projects alongside experienced industry professionals

• Flexible working arrangements that support both your career and personal life

• A flat organisational structure where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter

• A strong focus on your learning, development, and professional growth

• A culture that values commitment, meaningful contributions, and having fun

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Fair Hiring

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace drives innovation, creativity, and stronger results. At PEAK Wind, we are committed to fair and transparent hiring processes, welcoming candidates from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our hiring decisions focus on what each person brings to the role and our team, and we are committed to ensuring transparent salary structures, with pay decisions based on clear, objective, and gender‑neutral criteria. Salary information, including the relevant salary band, will be shared with candidates when they are invited to a first interview.

How to Apply

We look forward to receiving your application. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been found. Please apply directly through our website. If you have any questions or would like to know more about the position, please contact People & Development at recruitment@peak-wind.com.

About PEAK Wind

PEAK Wind is an independent renewable energy specialist in commercial, financial, and technical operations, delivering advisory, intelligence, and asset management services to investors and developers around the world. From onshore and offshore wind generation to Power-to-X, we work across the entire energy lifecycle to optimise operations and maintenance, enhance asset performance, and provide a holistic view of renewable infrastructure portfolios.

Our values - Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity - are reflected in everything we do, from how we support our clients to how we collaborate as a team. At PEAK Wind, you will be able to apply your professional skills in a dynamic environment and experience a meaningful responsibility and involvement.

Summary

Please note this internship will be a minimum of three months, you must be enrolled as a student on a PhD course and available to start no later than 1st June 2027

Within Apple’s Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning organization (AIML), you can take part in the ongoing revolution that machine learning plays in daily life. Apple’s fully-integrated hardware and software provide unique opportunities to deliver amazing experiences, all while prioritizing user privacy. As an AIML intern, you will get to explore new methods, apply machine learning to solve ambitious problems, advance state-of-the art technology through research and publications, challenge existing metrics or protocols, and develop new theories that will impact the way we understand machine learning and the experiences it can enable. Come collaborate with some of the best in the business and help build the world's most innovative products and experiences.

Description

In an AIML internship, you will collaborate with researchers, engineers, and program/project managers to tackle innovative challenges. You will also receive technical mentorship and guidance that allows you to learn new things every day, gain practical skills, build real world experience, develop a greater understanding of our industry, and form valuable connections. Together, you and your team will partner to design and implement an innovative solution for a Machine Learning problem that is meaningful. At the end of your internship, you will have the opportunity to meet and present your work to AIML leadership. jobs.occupation: Assistant Professors in Electronic Systems (with the possibility of tenure-track)
jobs.description:
At the Technical Faculty of IT and Design, Department of Electronic Systems, one or more positions as Assistant Professor in Electronic Systems are open for appointments from June 1, 2027, or soon after. The positions are available for a period of 4 years (with the possibility of tenure-track). The positions are with the department's research groups located at the university campus in Copenhagen.

Your profile and work tasks
We seek to appoint one or more Assistant Professors (with the possibility of Tenure-Track) to conduct research, teaching, and knowledge exchange, and to grow and develop the department's research activities within our subject fields.

The positions require internationally recognized research experience within one or more of the following areas:

• Cyber security
• Privacy engineering
• Computer Systems
• Edge/cloud computing
• High-Performance Computing (HPC)
• Data Engineering
• Big Data Infrastructure
• Machine Learning Systems
The main tasks and responsibilities include:

• developing a research profile and providing valuable contributions to science.
• providing research-based teaching and supervision within at least one subject area.
• participating in grant application activities
• coordinating own projects and contributing to an active academic environment
Your competencies
You have an interest in collaborating with external partners and experience from participating in grant applications. You have also contributed to workplace well-being, collaboration, equal treatment, diversity, and a good working environment.

Selected candidates should demonstrate development potential in science and have peer-reviewed publications in recognized journals and books or anthologies. Under the leadership of others, you can plan and carry out individual teaching and supervision activities with a focus on the students' learning.

Who we are
In electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 700 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model. 

The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, cyber security, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide. 

The department places significant emphasis on supporting early career researchers and provides comprehensive career and personal development programmes, specifically designed to assist individual academics in achieving their professional objectives.

You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

Qualification requirements
Appointment as Assistant Professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

Tenure-track
When appointing tenure track assistant professors, Aalborg University also place particular emphasis on:

• The candidate can demonstrate a high degree of autonomy in their previous education and employment path
• The candidate shows considerable potential and is among the best in their field
• The candidate has academic experience from several universities and/or research institutions and preferably international experience
• The candidate is a skilled communicator
• The candidate writes and speaks English at the academic level
• The candidate is expected to meet the criteria for permanent employment as an associate professor at Aalborg University at the end of the tenure track process
Evaluation and promotion proces:

• Annual internal follow-ups to review progress on the promotion plan and ensure the assistant professor remains on track.
• A mid-term evaluation, based on external review, conducted by an internal assessment committee after three years.
• A final review by an external committee after 5.5 years. A positive outcome leads to a tenured appointment as Associate Professor.
• Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorship 
Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorship
The assessment in connection with transition to tenure as an associate professor normally takes place in the final six months of the tenure track assistant professors’ employment. However, the employee may request that an assessment take place at an earlier time in the first four years. If this assessment finds that the employee is not academically qualified, they may request another assessment within the final six months of their period of employment. A maximum of two assessments may take place. 

The assessment, on transition to the associate professorship, will as a minimum, emphasize the following qualifications in relation to the scientific subject area of the tenure track assistant professorship: 

• Research qualifications equivalent to the level that can be achieved on the basis of satisfactorily completed employment as tenure track assistant professor.
• Documented scientific production at international level. Assessment will be based on up to ten selected publications selected by the employee.
• Documentation of pedagogical supervision and upgrading of qualifications, including a positive written assessment of teaching qualifications. The assessment will also be based on the employee's teaching portfolio.
• The level of contribution to an active academic environment as well as the ability to collaborate and build relationships.
• The level of experience with grant proposals and experience of communicating research to relevant stakeholders. 
If the tenure track assistant professor fails to request that their qualifications be assessed in the last year of their period of employment or if they are assessed as not academically qualified, the university must immediately initiate dismissal proceedings in accordance with the collective agreement rules. 

How to apply  
Your application must include the following: 

• Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
• Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
• Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
• List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications. 
• Documentation of teaching qualifications. Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this .
• Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
• Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
• References/recommendations 
You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? 
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

 Further information 
Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Tenure track assistant professor/Tenure track researcher”.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.
